Customer Statement of Account
Go to the customers module from left navigation panel and open “Statement Of Account”
Here you have to select the date range first and after that the customer name or the company name and press search button.
We have 2 options under it:
1. Ledger Report: This will show you the every transaction related to that individual or the company. All the agreement and invoices and deposits will come here. It will also show you that is there any Debit or Credit remaining to that contact or is everything is balanced with that particular.
2. Outstanding Invoices: Here you can see that how much pending amount is there with that particular contact. It will show you all the outstanding invoices.

title: Customer Balance Summary
text:

Go to the customers module from left navigation panel and open “Balance Summary”
Here you have to select the date range and all the remaining balances will come here.
We have 3 options here:
1. ALL: In all it shows you the complete data of all the Debit’s and Credit’s in the system with the customer information,
2. With Debit Balance: It show’s you all the customers with the debit balance to the system. According to our system the Debit Balance shows the amount and customers to whom we have to pay.
3. With Credit Balance: It show’s you all the customers with Credit balance. If there are some entries in this option then it means we have to charge it from the customer. These are the pending balance.

a. Rental
b. Fines
c. Miscellaneous
For rental agreement we will select the rental option and a new window popup will appear.
If you enter the agreement number or customer number then the related invoice will come under other wise if you only select the date and all the pending invoices will be available under it.

Daily invoice are generated when the agreement is closed for complete amount.

There is small blue button with every vehicle group name. When you click on that a new window pops up and you have to define the tariff here:
1. You have to select the type whether its daily or weekly or monthly select that.
2. Second tab is about the diffrent option for the same tariff.
3. Now you have to select the days ranges from 0 till the number of days you want to charge how much for these days.
a, You can define diffrent rate for diffrent days.
b, It is charged on daily basis.
c, Last column is about the young driver rate if you charge extra from young driver then enter the value otherwise leave it blank.

6. In the second tab there is a second option for Weekend Rental and when yu open that tab here you have to define if you charge extra on the weekends then enter the days and rates accordingly and you can select the hourly range from there.
7. The third tab is about the protections or you can call it insurance. You can add per day rate from here for the insurances if you charge and you add multiple insurance from here.
8. Fourth tab is for mileage if you charge on the basis of milleage or if there is a certain limit on milleage than add the limit in allowed and enter the per km rate in Excess option.
9. the last option in rental tariff is about the extra things or services that you provide with the cars like (GPS, Baby Seat, Wifi or any other thing) you can add there rates from here and you can charge them accordingly.

title: Email Sending Settings
text:
Email Sending Settings
Email (SMTP)
The Tab “Email (SMTP)” allows you to make the settings to allow you to send various emails to your customers. By default, after having signed up on our applications, the email will be sent to your customers from speed auto systems but after having done the settings the email will be sent as per your desire from your own email id and your own name. This can be done as:-
In “Default from (sender) email address” enter your own email address from which you need to send the email.
In “Default from (sender) display name” enter your desired name to be shown on email.
In “SMTP host” enter your SMTP host address given by your service provider such as “smtp.gmail.com” if you are using the Gmail suite.
In SMTP port enter the desired number provided by your service provider such as “587” in most of the cases of Gmail suite.
Select “Use SSL” if the Gmail suite is being used, again this option is to be used as per requirements of your service provider.
In “User Name” either enter the same email address already entered in “Default from (sender) email address” above or email address on which the services have been acquired by you.
Enter the password of the email id on which the service is activated by your service provider.
After having done above all press the “Save” button below and enter some email id in “Test Email Settings” and press “SEND TEST EMAIL” button, if you receive a mail on given email id the settings have been done correctly otherwise check your settings again. If you are unable to activate your email, contact our Support Team by email, direct call or Speed Support Feature, given on our mobile apps to directly approach us.

Roles. To create various roles as well as the limit of access to the application as per their assigned role/task. These roles are to be assigned to various users subsequently.
Users. All users are created, edited or deleted here and assigned the role al Their permissions can also be modified from here also.

Branches:

A branch can be deleted or details about a branch can be edited by clicking the “ACTIONS” button attached to that specific branch. A branch can only be deleted until no action is taken from that branch, once any action has been done now that branch can’t be deleted.
Roles:
Keeping in view the job being performed by every individual, certain roles are defined here such as Admin, Fleet Manager or Booking Manager etc.
To create a new Role click “+ CREATE NEW ROLE” on right top corner.
If you want every new user, being created in the system, to be assigned with the same role as default then select the “Default” checkbox beside it.
By selecting the “Permissions” tag you can select the level of access, to information, to users assigned to that specific role.
A user can be edited or deleted by selecting the “ACTIONS” button attached to it less Admin, User, and Customer which can only be edited.
Users:
All the users using the application will be added and assigned a specific role here.

To assign a role, select the Roles Tag. Tick all the roles to be assigned to this specific user.

Languages:

Common

These can be added by clicking the “Choose File” and picking the file where you have saved these.
Document Nos

Same way numbering of invoices and various vouchers etc.
User Management
The Fourth tab works to manage the users’ initial access process to the application.
Email (SMTP)
The last Tab allows you to make the settings to allow your application to send various emails to your customers.

Cost-savings potential: Preventative maintenance, made feasible by routine inspections, can result in long term financial savings. Early problem detection and resolution can reduce the need for expensive breakdowns and repairs.
Brand Reputation: Your limo’s look and performance directly impact how people perceive your brand. Maintaining your vehicles shows you are reliable and professional, improving your standing in the field.
Preparing for a Mobile Vehicle Inspection
Being ready is crucial before you begin checking your limo fleet. Set up a program for routine inspections, gather the required tools and equipment, and make thorough inspection checklists. Being structured ensures that every important component is noticed, speeding up the inspection procedure.
Conducting a Thorough Exterior Inspection
Body Condition: Start by looking at the limo’s body in general. Look for corrosion warning signs such as dents, scratches, or other damage.
Tires, Wheels, and Brakes: To ensure safe travel, check the tires for deterioration, examine the wheels for damage, and confirm that the brakes are in good working order.
Lights, Signals, and Mirrors: Check that all lights, signals, and mirrors work properly to improve visibility and safety.
Windshield and Windows: Check for cracks or chips that could endanger passenger safety or violate laws.
A Comprehensive Interior Inspection
Passenger Cabin: Make sure the interior is spotless, cozy, and free of any flaws that can detract from the experience for the passengers.
Seating: Ensure that the seats are functional and pleasant by inspecting their state and condition.
Entertainment Systems and Climate Control: Test entertainment systems and climate control to ensure passengers have a comfortable trip.
Safety Equipment: In an emergency, confirm the availability and state of safety equipment, such as first aid kits.
Examining the Engine and Mechanical Components
Engine: Check the engine for leaks and odd noises, which could indicate more serious problems.
Fluid Levels: Verify the hoses, belts, and fluid levels to ensure everything works.
Gearbox and Drivetrain: To ensure smooth functioning, test the gearbox and drivetrain.
Exhaust System and Emissions: To comply with environmental regulations, assess the exhaust system and emissions.
Addressing Vehicle Maintenance and Repairs
Keep meticulous records of all inspection results and upkeep requirements. Establish a routine maintenance program with periodic inspections and take immediate action to resolve any problems. Consider whether you should manage maintenance in-house or outsource it depending on your ability and resources.
Leveraging Mobile Inspection Apps and Tools
To simplify the inspection process, consider employing mobile inspection apps and technologies. The benefits of these digital systems include simple recordkeeping, effective reporting, and improved data analytic capabilities. Explore the popular inspection applications and tools that best meet your needs.
Staying Compliant with Regulations
Limo operators must comply with regional, national, and local laws. Regulations are subject to modification, so it’s critical to remain educated and modify your activities to comply.
Conclusion
Mobile vehicle inspections are a requirement in the cutthroat world of limousine services and a competitive advantage. Success depends on putting safety first, following rules, and keeping a positive brand reputation. Following the instructions in this manual will help limo companies keep their fleet in top shape and ensure that every passenger has a safe and comfortable ride. Keep in mind that a properly maintained fleet not only demonstrates your dedication to quality but also serves as a catalyst for the growth of your company.
